top_reviews.title: Great boots for pretty much everything!
top_reviews.text:
I have always had issues buying boots. I've owned lots of leather boots, including high end types from red wings and so on; all ranging from work to pro hiking boots. None of them were very comfortable, nor did they last long. I put a lot of time and effort into finding the perfect boot for me and I am glad to say that these are the ones. The fit and finish on them is spectacular, just looking at the stitching, the cuts, the gauge and color of the leather, how the rivets are attached, the tongue, EVERYTHING is top notch about this boot. Now, as for sizing I normally wear a size 12 regular, I went with the 12 2E and they fit me just like socks if not better, I have a bit of wiggle room, but thats good since if I'm walking a lot my feet can swell a bit, plus it doesn't hurt to put on a thicker sock. Break-in isn't too bad, they're still stiff and are not conforming to my foot in some areas, but I know it'll all take time. So far most of the pressure is on the top of my foot, my little toes and a smidge on the back of my heel. If you are considering buying this boot DO IT. IT'S AWESOME!!

Some Concerns:
Shoelaces: When I receive the box the skinny rope laces were laced on and a pair of fat ribbon laces were included. So that's a bonus that the company sends an extra pair out. Now, the rope laces were pretty skimpy so I upgraded to a kevlar lace that I also purchase on Amazon, definitely a good idea. The ribbon laces are good but they look a bit "extra" and if thats your thing you'll love them.
Insole: There is none. I was kind of concerned but there was nothing separating your foot from the interior lining in the shoe. So far this has caused me no issues, it was just a bit concerning. I'm still considering getting an insole but so far no gripes.

Also, I greatly suggest polishing and waxing these boots regularly, not only will it make the leather look gorgeous but it will help hydrate the leather and also making the boot a bit water proof. Other than that the boots are great! Definitely a good purchase!

top_reviews.title: The Deal with Danner EE Fit—Read Me
top_reviews.text:
Gentlemen, I ordered 5 pairs of boots in various boot/insole combinations, including a pair of Merrell Wilderness boots. I tried the Danner 10’s without insoles, 10s with Airthotic, 10.5s w/& w/o Airthotics, both sizes with the DXTs, all of that in both the traditional EE and their narrower Mountain Light 2 in those sizes with a D width and in two different leathers! Amazon returns hates me.

Here’s the result: Danner Mountain Light with their fancier DXT Comfort Footbed Insole in my usual 10.5 size was the right fit. I am a 10.5 D in almost every other shoe. My Allen Edmonds, Aldens, Bostonians, Bass, you name it: 10.5 D (medium) fits. For those shopping boots in general, the Merrell Wilderness were too wide in the toe box. That’s a shame because they are unquestionably the more sturdy boot. These are a great second place finisher with the advantage of being fairly well wearable right out of the box (the Merrells are brutally stiff) and with the lace-to-toe design. I’m sure they’ll be great 10-year boots. Hope this helps someone!

top_reviews.title: Danner Mountain Light Cascade
top_reviews.text: Had a pair that my brother passed down to me many many years ago.  I saw these and it brought me back.  I am more than pleased, the comfort and the fit are amazing.  Danner has been putting out quality products for a long time and these boots exceeded my expectations.  I believe them to be a bit lighter than my first pair.  I'm anxious to hit the mountains.
